summary: Added git_user stamp in routes/overlay.js: when status becomes in_progress, runs `git config user.name` via execFileSync (guarded try/catch) and stores result in T.ov.git_users[b.key]. Added git_user field to the buildGraph task detail object in daemon.js (line ~1215), reading from ovWs.git_users with null fallback. Both files pass node -c syntax check.

subject: Fix 1: Stamp git_user on task at start_task time
description: In routes/overlay.js, when status=in_progress is processed, read `git config user.name` from the workspace (gitSafe call) and store it in a new overlay.git_users[task_key] field. Expose git_user on the task detail (buildGraph node). This is the prerequisite for fix 2 (token-delta work_sessions).
